newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom hits record high.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom hits record high.

text.p: Portugal Telecom (PT) rose two percent to 4,227 escudos, a record high, in heavy trade on the back of strong interest from funds and institutions, dealers said.
Dealers said it was an extension of the interest seen last Thursday which had then been interrupted by the big sell-off in financial markets on Friday.
Some traders said that the stock could eventually reach 4,300 escudos, although getting there would not be easy.
The rise of the stock's price in New York and the strength of the dollar were important factors behind the advance in Lisbon, dealers said.
But the stock was also being bought on fundamental grounds, they added.
